vintage: Eurostat regional accounts 2023 (jobs by branch, NUTS 3) and structural business statistics 2024 (jobs by division, NUTS 2)

rule.text: A district appears when its industries' share of the urban area's jobs is at least 1.25× their share of Europe's jobs (the location quotient), with at least 1,000 jobs or 1% of the area's jobs, or when one of its specialities is at least 3× the European share with 1,000 jobs. Districts are ranked by jobs above the European norm (jobs − jobs ÷ LQ), five at most. Harbor needs a seaport handling 500,000 tonnes a year in or next to the urban area, Aerodrome an airport with 50,000 passengers (when infrastructure.json is built; otherwise Harbor needs a hex on the water or a river). Government plaza (public administration, education and health, which Eurostat publishes together for regions) also needs 1.1× its country's own share, except in national capitals. The city type is its strongest district, unless a district or one of its specialities is 6× the norm with 3% of the area's jobs; it is named after the speciality when that is 3× the norm. Jobs by branch come from Eurostat's regional accounts for the urban area's NUTS 3 regions (counted where people work, self-employed included); finance, manufacturing and the public administration-education-health group use them directly. The other districts and every speciality use Eurostat's business statistics by NACE division, published only for NUTS 2 regions: each division's regional jobs are shared out among the NUTS 3 regions by their jobs in its branch, so a city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch. Figures withheld as confidential are estimated from what the NUTS 1 or national total leaves over; '≥' marks a lower bound where nothing was left to estimate from. Europe is the 37 countries for branches and the 31 publishing business statistics for divisions (not Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Kosovo).
rule.county_note: Same rule for each NUTS 3 region, its divisions shared out from its NUTS 2 region; Harbor and Aerodrome need a port or airport in the region itself.

catalog.name: Campus
catalog.description: Research and development, software and IT, telecoms, engineering.
catalog.caveat: Universities and public research are outside the business statistics Eurostat publishes for regions. Specialities are regional: the city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch, scaled to its own jobs in that branch.

catalog.name: Commercial hub
catalog.description: Banks, insurers, fund managers and exchanges.
catalog.caveat: Specialities are regional: the city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch, scaled to its own jobs in that branch.

catalog.name: Industrial zone

sub.C32: Medical devices, jewellery, toys and other goods

catalog.caveat: Aircraft, ships and trains name a city 'Shipyard city' when it also has a Harbor district, else 'Aerospace city' (aircraft are most of this industry's jobs in Europe; trains are counted here too). Specialities are regional: the city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch, scaled to its own jobs in that branch.

catalog.name: Harbor
catalog.description: Shipping, and the warehousing and cargo handling around ports.
catalog.caveat: Warehousing and transport services also serve airports and inland logistics; the district needs a seaport. Specialities are regional: the city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch, scaled to its own jobs in that branch.

catalog.name: Theater square
catalog.description: Performing arts, film, TV and music, broadcasting, publishing, museums.
catalog.caveat: Public theatres and museums run by governments are often outside the business statistics. Specialities are regional: the city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch, scaled to its own jobs in that branch.

catalog.name: Entertainment complex
catalog.description: Hotels and holiday lodging, sports and amusement parks, gambling.
catalog.caveat: Specialities are regional: the city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch, scaled to its own jobs in that branch.

catalog.name: Aerodrome
catalog.caveat: Airport ground services are counted with warehousing (Harbor). The district needs an airport. Specialities are regional: the city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch, scaled to its own jobs in that branch.

catalog.name: Government plaza
catalog.description: Public administration and defence, education, health and social work.
catalog.caveat: Eurostat publishes public administration together with education and health for regions, so hospitals, schools and universities count here too. Their share mostly follows how much of a country's health and education is public, so outside national capitals this district also needs the share to be 1.1× the country's own.

catalog.name: Encampment
catalog.caveat: No regional defence employment is published for Europe: this district comes only from military.json, when that file exists.

catalog.name: Aqueduct
catalog.description: Power and gas supply, water, sewage, waste and recycling.
catalog.caveat: Specialities are regional: the city has its NUTS 2 region's mix of industries within each branch, scaled to its own jobs in that branch.
